subject: [PATCH] MAINTAINERS: x86/mm add myself as reviewer

reviews.author: Peter Zijlstra
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch and added an Acked-by tag, indicating approval without explicit review.
reviews.raw_body:
On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 08:54:44PM -0500, Rik van Riel wrote:
> arch/x86/mm is an area where the maintainers are spread
> pretty thin, which I care about, and know something
> about after various TLB flushing adventures.
> 
> I should probably help review things there.
> 
> Signed-off-by: Rik van Riel <riel@surriel.com>

Acked-by: Peter Zijlstra (Intel) <peterz@infradead.org>

> ---
>  MAINTAINERS | 1 +
>  1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
> 
> diff --git a/MAINTAINERS b/MAINTAINERS
> index 222b7fc2c3aa..ef9d082cf1f4 100644
> --- a/MAINTAINERS
> +++ b/MAINTAINERS
> @@ -30413,6 +30413,7 @@ X86 MM
>  M:	Dave Hansen <dave.hansen@linux.intel.com>
>  M:	Andy Lutomirski <luto@kernel.org>
>  M:	Peter Zijlstra <peterz@infradead.org>
> +R:	Rik van Riel <riel@surriel.com>
>  L:	linux-kernel@vger.kernel.org
>  S:	Maintained
>  T:	git git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/tip/tip.git x86/mm
> -- 
> 2.56.0
>

2026-11-12.patch_summary: The patch adds Rik van Riel as a reviewer for the x86/mm area in MAINTAINERS, addressing concerns about maintainership spread thin.
